action_items: (Low) Extend/reactivate owner@elegance.com trial in seed so multi-tenant WhatsApp isolation checks (status not_created, test-send 409) can run automatically.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/whatsapp_link.py:link_prefs updates only tenants where wa_gateway exists (`{'wa_gateway': {'$exists': True}}`) — silently succeeds with prefer_over_sms in the response body even when nothing was matched (e.g. a tenant that unlinked between GET and PUT). Consider returning 409/404 when matched_count == 0 so the UI can prompt the user to re-link.

routes/whatsapp_link.py:PairIn / TestSendIn use min_length=10 at Pydantic level but then compute `re.sub(r'\D', '', body.phone)` after — a phone like 'abcdefghij' (10 chars, 0 digits) passes Pydantic and is caught by the 400 below. Consider a Pydantic `@field_validator` on phone that strips non-digits and enforces min-digits, so validation always yields 422 with a consistent shape instead of a mix of 400 and 422.

routes/whatsapp_link.py:link_test_send default message contains an em-dash and ✦ glyph — fine for WhatsApp, but reminder that some legacy carriers/preview clients render glyphs as '?'. Consider making the default text configurable per-tenant.
